companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.value:
Shenzhen EPT Electronic Technology Co., Ltd is a high-tech corporation, who aims at R&D, Production and Marketing electrommunication products including Bluetooth Speakers, Power Banks and USB Flash Drives. Our Major Markets are in Europe and America

EPT has a great fortune as we have a good team that has an extraordinary amount of great technology and engineering talent.
Besides, we have an strict management system that peruses for Creativity, quality controlling, best services.

For the past few years, due to our honesty and hard working, we won trusts from clients all over the world and become trust-worthy parter of many prestigious organizations such as US Army, LG, VW.

With many years production & management experience and technical advantages, EPT puts more time and money in absorbing advanced techniques to develop new products for leading the market.

We are committed to supplying customers with the highest quality and most competitive prices. To obtain sustainable development, we set the management concept of " Clients Paramount, Credit First " and adhere to the tenet of "Always meet or exceed customers' requirements."

In the future, EPT will pay more attention to product innovation and add more invests to build a scientific human resource system, so as to provide customers with our best service and products, in the mean time, develop with clients together.
